title: Immigration and Nationality Act
verified_how: Fetched govinfo USCODE-2024 8 U.S.C. 1101. The Short Title note says the Act 'may be cited as the "Immigration and Nationality Act"'.
notes: Covers visas, employment-based categories, employment authorization and employer sanctions (INA 274A, 8 U.S.C. 1324a). Work-permit detail is largely in regulations at 8 CFR.
